row.evidence: Airtable's SCIM docs say "SCIM user management is only available for the Business, Enterprise, and Enterprise Scale plans, while SCIM group management is only available for the Enterprise and Enterprise Scale plans"; the pricing page prices Business at $45/user/month billed annually.
row.notes: Changed since June: SCIM user provisioning now starts at Business ($45/seat/mo annual), not Enterprise Scale. The SCIM API reference and billing-plans page list Business as a SCIM user-management plan; the client-rendered pricing comparison table also checks 'SCIM user provisioning' and SAML SSO for Business and Enterprise Scale (seen in a headless render, not quotable from the static page). Status stays gated (above the Team tier). SCIM group provisioning ('SCIM-synced user groups') still needs Enterprise Scale. June's 'typically $65+/u/mo' Enterprise Scale figure had no first-party source and is dropped. SSO is a prerequisite for SCIM create/update, and SCIM is limited to ELA and 'claiming' enterprise account types. The Enterprise API (user list/get/manage/delete/logout, admin grants) and the audit log API are Enterprise Scale only. Monthly prices ($24 Team, $54 Business) appear only in the client-rendered cards.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free plan cards render client-side; prices not quoted. Web API on Free covers base data only.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: SCIM user provisioning only; SCIM group management is Enterprise Scale.

auth.token_source: Personal access token or OAuth integration with scope enterprise.scim.usersAndGroups:manage, created by an Enterprise admin at https://airtable.com/create/tokens (service account token recommended for admins of multiple enterprises)

operations.notes: Deactivate/reactivate via the active attribute (provisioned/deactivated state). Group push and membership need Enterprise Scale.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated user is no longer associated with the enterprise plan and is greyed out in sharing dialogs; account and owned bases remain until an admin deletes the account in the UI (to transfer bases/workspaces) or via the Enterprise API. SCIM DELETE cannot remove the token owner or the sole owner of a workspace with multiple collaborators.

pagination.notes: startIndex and count; count defaults to all users.

custom.how: Airtable SSO extension urn:airtable:params:scim:schemas:extension:sso:2.0:User with emailDomain, used to route provisioning to a specific IdP and to provision off-domain users. No arbitrary custom attributes.

roles.how: SCIM cannot assign licences or seat types; use license-mapped user groups pushed via IdP sync and connected to an org unit or seat type.

rate_limits.text: No SCIM-specific limit documented. Web API: 5 requests/second per base and 50 requests/second for all traffic using a given user's or service account's personal access tokens; 429 then a 30-second wait.

limitations.text: SCIM group management (group push) is unavailable on Business; Business customers using the Entra gallery app must disable group mappings.
SCIM is only available for ELA and CLAIM enterprise account types; it manages only claimed (managed) users and supported SSO-managed external users.
Provisioning fails with a conflict if an unclaimed Airtable account already exists for the email; the account must be claimed first.
Vendor-built SCIM integrations exist for Okta and Entra ID only; other IdPs use the SCIM API directly.

capabilities.notes: User creation is SCIM-only; group read via GET /v0/meta/groups/{groupId}; admin role grant/revoke endpoints.

google.notes: Airtable's Google guide uses a custom SAML app in Google Workspace; no Google auto-provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: From Airtable's own OneLogin guide (an 'Airtable SAML application in OneLogin'); OneLogin's connector page not loaded. Provisioning only via the generic SCIM API.
